papers.title: The Arctic has warmed nearly four times faster than the globe since 1979
papers.authors: Rantanen, M., Karpechko, A. Y., Lipponen, A., et al.
papers.takeaway: Observational evidence confirms four-fold polar amplification driven by sea ice-albedo feedbacks, far exceeding CMIP6 model projections.

papers.title: Global Carbon Budget: Fossil Emissions and Land-Use Sink Dynamics
papers.authors: Friedlingstein, P., O'Sullivan, M., Jones, M. W., et al.
papers.takeaway: Global fossil fuel emissions reached unprecedented rates with less than 170 GtCO₂ remaining to stay below 1.5°C of warming.

papers.title: Critical transitions and compounding stressors in the Amazon forest system
papers.authors: Flores, B. M., Montoya, E., Sakschewski, B., et al.
papers.takeaway: By 2050, 10% to 47% of the Amazon forest will be exposed to compounding disturbances, risking a large-scale ecosystem tipping point.

papers.title: Aerosol optical properties and radiative forcing over the Indo-Gangetic Basin
papers.authors: Dey, S., Tripathi, S. N., Singh, R. P., & Holben, B. N.
papers.takeaway: Shallow planetary boundary layers in winter trap ground aerosol loadings, causing surface radiative cooling alongside lower tropospheric heating.

papers.title: Health and economic impact of air pollution across the states of India
papers.authors: India State-Level Disease Burden Initiative Air Pollution Collaborators
papers.takeaway: Ambient particulate pollution accounted for 1.67 million deaths in India, with Uttar Pradesh and the Gangetic plain experiencing the highest disease burden.

papers.title: The energetic basis of the urban heat island and surface radiometry
papers.journal: Quarterly Journal of the Royal Meteorological Society
papers.takeaway: Foundational formulation establishing how impervious urban geometry, canyon aspect ratio, and thermal inertia create localized urban heat deltas.

papers.title: Accelerated global glacier mass loss in the early twenty-first century
papers.authors: Hugonnet, R., McNabb, R., Berthier, E., et al.
papers.takeaway: High-mountain Asian and Himalayan glaciers accelerated their mass loss by over 60%, contributing directly to accelerated downstream discharge volatility.

papers.title: Split-window and single-channel algorithms for Land Surface Temperature from Landsat
papers.authors: Jimenez-Munoz, J. C., Cristobal, J., Sobrino, J. A., et al.
papers.journal: IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing
papers.takeaway: Mathematical validation of single-channel thermal infrared radiometry algorithms for Landsat TIRS Band 10 atmospheric correction.
